g.text: Dedicated one-chassis test. No evpn-cni, Multus, NAD,
CNI ADD/CHECK/DEL, or Netlink remote writer.
The OVSDB importer is explicitly selected for this network.
reserve exact topology; deploy native kind + FRR
verify ownership, readiness and management CA
BGPConfiguration CRD -> k8gobgp reconciliation -> managed gobgpd.
Manager + daemon share one upstream DaemonSet image.
Framework clients use local Unix gRPC; no competing upstream Netlink writer.
AddPath Type-2 MAC and MAC/IP; retain UUID
Remote route import and OVSDB programming
RD, RT, VNI, MAC/IP, next hop
ensure owned provider bridge and bridge mapping
ensure owned localnet LSP on configured physnet
ensure owned VXLAN interface and port
ping local endpoint to remote workload
asynchronously DeletePath exact UUIDs for A
verify A absent and B remains
verify endpoint B still reaches remote workload
Remote route withdrawal and owned cleanup
observe authoritative RIB without remote route
retry owned provider-bridge deletion when safe
verify remote Type-2 absent and Type-3 remains
verify remote Type-2 absent; peer remains established
verify pre-existing unowned VXLAN interfaces remain
verify endpoint B remains; remote localnet LSP absent
remove endpoint and Framework logical switch
verify no stale owned OVN/OVS state and restore inventories
collect diagnostics; destroy exact owned topology
owned resources absent; unrelated resources preserved
The mapping is route network/VNI/next hop to the owned provider
path; MAC and optional IP are validated and retained in route
ownership metadata. The current opt-in integration supports one network
Cross-database steps are not atomic. Retry/refuse on partial cleanup;
never force-delete controller-owned patches or foreign ports.
Partial per-MAC learned-FDB invalidation is not accepted.
